name: Jewelcrafting recipes never drop on an Expansion 0 session (#7929)
contract: Loot::AddItem (LootMgr.cpp) never consulted the loot owner's session expansion, so a Jewelcrafting recipe (item class 9, subclass 10) could be added to loot for a character whose account is Expansion 0 (Classic), although Trainer.cpp's ProfessionExpansion keeps Jewelcrafting unlearnable at every trainer below EXPANSION_THE_BURNING_CRUSADE (#6026). Design: Truesilver Boar (21944) is such a recipe. The fix rejects the item in Loot::AddItem when the loot owner's session expansion is below EXPANSION_THE_BURNING_CRUSADE. forced_loot_count adds the item directly through Loot::AddItem with the actor as loot owner, bypassing the loot table RNG, and reports how many uncollected copies survive that call.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: a Jewelcrafting recipe never drops for an Expansion 0 session
REGRESSION: the same recipe still drops for an Expansion 2 (Wrath) session
CONTROL: an unrelated item is unaffected by the gate on an Expansion 0 session
